title: Allan F. Packer
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult.
Missionary to Andes Mission and Colombia-Venezuela Mission.
Married Terri Anne Bennett, Salt Lake Temple, 1970. Eight children.
Bachelor's degree in Electronic Engineering Technology from BYU.
Employment: In-field representative for the Church's missionary department. Vice president of various companies.
Young Men president; Scoutmaster; High Councilor; Counselor in four bishoprics; Bishop; Counselor in Stake Presidency; Member of the Young Men General Board.
President of the Spain Malaga Mission, 2001-04
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
